summary.headline: Infinity Infoway H1 FY27 revenue rose 106.22% to Rs 16.81 crore, with EBITDA margin at 50.68% and PAT margin at 29.89%.
summary.overview: Management reported H1 FY27 (six months to 30 Sep 2026) revenue from operations of Rs 16.81 crore versus Rs 8.15 crore a year earlier, up 106.22%. EBITDA rose about 109.68% to Rs 8.52 crore (50.68% margin) and PAT rose 79.36% to Rs 5.02 crore (29.89% margin). Growth was supported by the ZeroTouch secured examination paper product, which began booking revenue in H1 with larger billing expected from Q3, and by a headcount increase from 156 to 178. Depreciation increased as products under development in FY26 went into use and as GPU and ZeroTouch device assets were added. Management also outlined plans to enter international markets, starting with the Gulf, then Southeast Asia and Europe.

segments.name: Education ERP (government and education clients)
segments.commentary: Serves 61+ education clients, with recurring revenue from 28; modules cover admissions, academics, examinations, finance, fees and HR (30+ modules). Management described it as the core business.

segments.name: Industry / enterprise ERP
segments.commentary: 35+ industry customers, with recurring revenue from 16; industrial ERP with AI-enabled solutions is a stated priority.

segments.name: ZeroTouch (secured examination paper solution)
segments.commentary: Early-stage revenue in H1 described as nominal; billing is per question paper printed and delivered, with exams started in October 2026 and a good amount of revenue expected in Q3. Management cites EBITDA margin above 50-60%, and 20-22% of revenue targeted from it within two years.

guidance_outlook: Management expects to maintain the current H1 run rate (about 100% growth) based on the Rs 78 crore order book and pipeline; beating it is described as difficult.
Management says H2 will be better than H1, citing a five-year pattern of Q3 and Q4 outperforming Q1 and Q2.
Margins are expected to be manageable for at least the next couple of quarters, with AI helping to lower costs; management cautioned that exponential growth could pressure margins initially.

International revenue is targeted in FY27 (Gulf first, then Southeast Asia and Europe), with an initial focus on private schools, colleges and universities. ZeroTouch is not planned abroad for at least one year.
ZeroTouch is expected to contribute 20-22% of revenue within two years, per management.
capex_capacity: Fixed-asset additions in H1 included upgrades to ZeroTouch devices after Q1 demonstrations and higher-spec GPUs for in-house AI model and LLM experiments on physical servers.
Depreciation of Rs 1.72 crore in H1 reflects ZeroTouch and one or two other products that moved from development into use in FY26. Management did not give a split between the two.
Team size rose from 156 to 178 during H1 to support sales, execution and outbound marketing.
Service presence now covers more than 10 Indian states.
demand_pricing: Order book of Rs 78 crore as of 30 Sep 2026.

ZeroTouch is priced per question paper printed and delivered; higher volumes attract a lower per-unit charge. Current focus is government examinations (competitive, board, university), with private clients as a second phase.
Gujarat Gyan Guru Quiz (G3Q) season 3 launched in September 2026 on a platform Infinity manages for the Government of Gujarat. Season 1 (2023) drew more than 27 lakh students.
AI Manthan 2.0 in Kanpur: live demonstration of ZeroTouch, with approval to pilot it in examinations.
Infinity reports 76 examinations conducted via its portals and more than 18 lakh students served.

qa_highlights.question: Why did employee costs increase?
qa_highlights.answer: Headcount rose from 156 to 178 in H1 to expand sales and execution capability and reach more than 10 states.

qa_highlights.question: What revenue has ZeroTouch booked and what are its margins and two-year outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 revenue is nominal; Q3 is expected to be larger as exams started in October. Management cites EBITDA margin above 50-60% and expects 20-22% of revenue from ZeroTouch within two years.

qa_highlights.question: Is ZeroTouch limited to government clients, and how is it priced?
qa_highlights.answer: Government is the focus for mass volume and security; private clients are a later phase. Pricing is per question paper printed and delivered, with a lower rate at higher volume.

qa_highlights.question: What is the international strategy and timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Start with private schools, colleges and universities in the Gulf, then Southeast Asia and Europe. Management expects international revenue within FY27 and does not plan ZeroTouch abroad for at least one year.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the rise in PP&E and depreciation?
qa_highlights.answer: ZeroTouch and one or two other FY26 development products now generate revenue and are being depreciated. Additions were ZeroTouch device upgrades and GPUs for in-house AI model work.

qa_highlights.question: What is the current order book and what is H1 total expense?
qa_highlights.answer: Order book is Rs 78 crore as of 30 Sep 2026. Total H1 expenses including depreciation were Rs 10.54 crore, of which Rs 1.72 crore was depreciation.

qa_highlights.question: Is there seasonality and what are the FY27-FY28 growth targets?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects H2 to be better than H1 and aims to keep the same run rate, with no explicit multi-year growth target given.

risks_watch: Margin sustainability: management said rapid scaling, and especially international expansion, could pressure margins in the near term.
International execution: management acknowledged an unfavourable international market, and the Gulf, Southeast Asia and Europe plans are untested.
ZeroTouch ramp: revenue is nominal so far; Q3 billing from exams started in October 2026 needs to show up in the next results.
Rising depreciation and employee costs from new assets and headcount growth.
Management did not give a formal FY27 or FY28 revenue guidance, and the H2 seasonality claim is based on historical patterns.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and margins, with a clear priority list (ZeroTouch, AI-enabled ERP, industrial ERP). Answers on ZeroTouch and international timelines were more hedged, and the CEO said some margin pressure was likely as the company scales.
key_quotes: We have more than double our operating revenue and we have increased a very good profitabilities margin.
So, as of now, we are focused on the government clients.
But at least upcoming couple of quarters or you can check couple - - at least a year, we have a complete planned order book and our business is on recurring mode.

growth.why: Management expects to maintain the H1 run rate of about 100% growth, backed by a Rs 78 crore order book (30 Sep 2026) and pipeline, with ZeroTouch billing from Q3 and international revenue targeted in FY27; no physical capacity additions were quantified, so backing is partial.
